data.narrative:
AGent Energy is a Seed-stage climate and energy company that has raised $6M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, peer-median valuation methodology was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set—only three or more datapoints meeting tight filters would support reliable triangulation via this method.

Stage-progression analysis was the primary applicable method. Using the $6M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next-stage rounds in frontier tech, this method implies a $15M valuation. This multiplier reflects observed progression patterns within the capital formation cycle, though it is not tied to company-specific metrics or revenue.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $13M to $17M, with a median point of $15M. Key uncertainties center on the absence of granular peer-stage data—the broader Climate & Energy universe offers limited direct comparability—and the reliance on a single methodology. Without revenue, customer traction, or technology de-risking milestones in the dataset, valuation precision is constrained to the stage-based step-up heuristic. Further diligence on product-market validation and capital efficiency would refine this range.
